topic: Sinking funds for big expenses vs getting surprised (Pierce vs Dahlia)

scenes.narration: One car repair sent him to a payday loan. Her? She paid cash. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym pointing at labeled jars reading CAR HOLIDAYS REPAIRS, comic burst banner reads PLAN AHEAD, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pierce and Dahlia both face the same predictable yearly expenses.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man pierce and woman dahlia each facing a calendar marked CAR INSURANCE, HOLIDAYS, TAXES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Car insurance, holidays, and tires hit them at the same times.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, three big bills floating labeled INSURANCE, HOLIDAYS, TIRES on a shared calendar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pierce treats every big bill like a total surprise attack.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, pierce jumping in fright as a giant bill labeled SURPRISE pops up behind him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: When the bill lands he scrambles for a credit card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, panicked pierce reaching for a credit card as a bill stamped DUE NOW lands on his desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dahlia sets aside small amounts into labeled sinking funds monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, dahlia dropping small coins into three labeled jars CAR HOLIDAYS TIRES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fifty dollars monthly for tires means six hundred ready by year end.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a jar labeled TIRES filling up, calendar pages flipping, banner reads SIX HUNDRED READY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every big expense already has its own quiet pile waiting.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a shelf of full labeled jars each ready for a different expense, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A surprise repair hits, and Pierce takes a payday loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, stressed pierce signing a PAYDAY LOAN paper beside a broken down car, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dahlia pulls cash from her repair jar and pays instantly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, calm dahlia handing cash from a jar labeled REPAIRS to a mechanic, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She paid zero interest while Pierce paid fees on everything.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, dahlia stamped ZERO INTEREST, pierce buried under fee receipts, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Predict big bills, fund them monthly in jars. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
